en.name: Inter Graves
en.body: Leo XIII's reply to the Peruvian bishops after their synod at Lima. He confirms their work and writes on the clergy, on Catholic education and on the care of the indigenous population.

fr.name: Inter Graves
fr.body: La réponse de Léon XIII aux évêques péruviens après leur synode de Lima. Il confirme leurs travaux et traite du clergé, de l'éducation catholique et du soin des populations autochtones.
